text: The Bible teaches that Jesus Christ will return physically and visibly to the earth. His return will be powerful and glorious, bringing final judgment and the full establishment of God's kingdom. While the exact time of His return is unknown, believers are instructed to remain watchful and faithful.

Scripture teaches that all people will one day be resurrected. Those who belong to Christ will be raised to eternal life, while those who reject Him will face judgment. This resurrection includes the restoration of the body, demonstrating God's power over death.

Heaven is the dwelling place of God and the eternal home promised to believers. The Bible describes a future new heaven and new earth where righteousness dwells. In this restored creation there will be no death, sorrow, or pain, and God will dwell with His people forever.

The Bible describes hell as a place of final judgment and separation from God. It is presented as the consequence for rejecting God's grace and truth. Scripture emphasizes this reality to warn humanity and call people to repentance and faith in Christ.

The Bible teaches that God will judge all humanity in perfect righteousness. Every person will give account for their life. Those who trust in Jesus Christ receive eternal life through His grace, while those who reject Him face judgment.
